newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Air Hong Kong to add European flights.
newsitem.headline: Air Hong Kong to add European flights.

text.p: Hong Kong's all-cargo airline, AHK Air Hong Kong Ltd, expects to increase its European service to a maximum five frequencies a week by May because of strong demand, according to the airline's newly appointed chief operating officer, Kenny Tang.

Air Hong Kong currently operates four Boeing 747- 200 frequencies a week to Brussels and Manchester via Dubai. Tang said the airline is enjoying high load factors of "at least 90 and 95 per cent and quite a few times 100 per cent loads." and is "very pleased" with current business.

Tang said he expects market conditions to be strong enough by late April or early May to add an additional, fifth frequency for which the airline already has traffic rights. --Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44-171-542-7706 Fax+5017
